3d-model-viewer.reason: Populated reset composition; A simple hub device is rendered live on a canvas with flat shading. agenda-contents-tracker.description: Agenda / contents tracker — actual demo stage.

animated-number-count-up.description: Animated number count-up — actual demo stage.

animated-transition-between-states.description: Animated transition between states — actual demo stage.

annotated-chart.reason: Completed labeled composition; The line draws in, then a shaded band and a callout mark the July launch and state the jump in words (+42% month over month), so the audience reads the point instead of hunting for it. Data is illustrative.

annotated-wireframe.reason: Completed labeled composition; A grey-box sketch stands in for the real screen, so attention goes to structure rather than styling. Each step drops a numbered marker on one region and adds the matching line to the legend, building the explanation part by part.

auto-animate-morph.reason: Slide 1 plus actual Slide 2 still; motion is demonstrated only in explicit Demo.

A scrim keeps the headline readable. Pause stops the loop; reduced motion shows a still frame.

explorable-example-with-sliders.description: Explorable example with sliders — actual demo stage.
explorable-example-with-sliders.reason: Populated reset composition; Move the request and agent sliders; utilisation, average wait and the curve update live. Reset restores 30 requests, 6 agents.

return-to-hub-button.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

sankey.reason: Populated reset composition; Band widths are proportional to dollars, so each node’s height equals its total in and out. Select a source or a spending node (click, or Tab then Enter) to isolate its flows and hear the split; hover a band for its value. Data is illustrative.

scatter-bubble.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each dot is one sales region placed by marketing spend and new customers; the dots then grow into bubbles whose area (not radius) shows average deal size, and a fitted trend line shows the correlation. Data is illustrative.

scenario-playback-transport.description: Scenario playback transport — actual demo stage.
scenario-playback-transport.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

scenario-toggle.reason: Completed labeled composition; One chart, three cases. Each step switches the active case: the bars move to that scenario’s monthly cash balance and the summary line restates what changes, so the audience compares cases on identical axes instead of flipping between three separate charts.

scope-bracket-diagram.description: Scope bracket diagram — actual demo stage.
scope-bracket-diagram.reason: Populated reset composition; The process runs left to right; the bracket above marks the steps this initiative owns and the bracket below marks what stays unchanged. Click a step, or press Enter on it, to move it in or out of scope and the brackets redraw around the new boundary. Reset restores the proposed scope.

scrubbable-numbers-reactive-document.description: Scrubbable numbers / reactive document — actual demo stage.
scrubbable-numbers-reactive-document.reason: Populated reset composition; The blue numbers are inputs: drag one left or right, or focus it and press the arrow keys, and every dependent figure in the sentence plus the twelve-month bars recompute at once. Monthly revenue = new teams × 12 months × seats × price; annual run rate = that × 12. Reset restores the defaults.

section-divider.reason: Completed labeled composition; A divider is a full slide that marks a chapter break: a large number, the chapter name and a small tracker of all chapters with the new one highlighted. Play moves from the last slide of chapter one to the divider, then into the first slide of chapter two.

segmented-progress-bar.description: Segmented progress bar — actual demo stage.
segmented-progress-bar.reason: Selected in-progress frame preserves the distinguishing focus/navigation cue.

sequence-diagram.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

show-and-play.reason: Reveal authored clip at build three, immediately pause using its real control; static poster preserves simulated clip label.

side-note.reason: Completed labeled composition; The chart carries the message; a small note in the margin explains how to read one part of it. Play draws the chart, then adds the note in muted type and a thin leader line to the dip it refers to, so the caveat sits next to the data instead of in a footnote.

simulated-browser-frame.description: Simulated browser frame — actual demo stage.
simulated-browser-frame.reason: Completed labeled composition; Drawn browser chrome (tab, address bar, window dots) frames a mock screen so it reads as a web product without using a real screenshot. The steps type the address, show a loading skeleton, then fill in the page; the corner label keeps it honest as simulated.

simulation-disclaimer.reason: Completed labeled composition; A mock product screen appears, then a banner states “Simulated. Not a real product screen.” and real-looking customer names swap to neutral placeholders. Use it whenever a slide shows a mockup that could be mistaken for a live system or real client data.

situation-complication-resolution.reason: Completed labeled composition; The opener runs in three beats. Situation states the shared context, Complication adds the tension that makes it a problem now, and Resolution answers it with the proposal. Play reveals one beat per step, with the resolution emphasized because it is the point of the deck.

skip-link-and-slide-announcer.description: Skip link and slide announcer — actual demo stage.
skip-link-and-slide-announcer.reason: Use actual Next control so visible live-region caption announces the changed slide.

slidedoc-page.reason: Completed labeled composition; A slidedoc page is written to be read, not projected: a full-sentence title, short paragraphs, a captioned chart and a source note, all on one idea. Play numbers the reading path one part at a time, from title to body to chart to footnote.

slope-chart.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each product is one line from its 2024 score to its 2026 score, so the angle shows the direction and size of change at a glance. After the lines draw, the two decliners are colored and labeled while the rest fade. Scores are illustrative.

small-multiples.reason: Completed labeled composition; Six identical mini line charts share one 0–100% scale and the same eight weeks, so shapes compare directly without a cluttered legend. After the lines draw, the one region moving against the rest is highlighted. Values are illustrative.

source-chips.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

sourced-footer.reason: Completed labeled composition; The chart builds, then a single footer line appears at the bottom of the slide naming the source, period, sample size and exclusions, with the key parts briefly highlighted. Readers can check the evidence without it competing with the headline. Values are illustrative.

sources-panel.reason: Completed labeled composition; A Sources entry sits in the top bar on every slide. Play opens the panel, which lists each reference with what it supports, and highlights the one behind the claim on screen. The panel is global, so it reads the same from any slide.

sparkline.reason: Completed labeled composition; A word-sized line draws itself next to the current value and ends in a dot on the latest point. It carries no axes: it gives the shape of the trend, while the number gives the value. Data is illustrative.

speaker-intro-card.description: Speaker intro card — actual demo stage.
speaker-intro-card.reason: Completed labeled composition; The card introduces the speaker before the content: a photo, name and role, three bullets on what they are responsible for, and a scope note saying what this talk covers and what it does not. Play builds those parts in order. The person and photo are invented placeholders.

speaker-view.reason: Completed labeled composition; The demo shows the presenter window: the current slide, the next slide, notes and a running clock. Play advances the talk so the preview, notes and timer change together, which is what the presenter sees while the audience sees one slide.

spectrum-scale.reason: Completed labeled composition; Two named extremes anchor a continuous scale, and each option is a marker on it, so the slide shows degree rather than yes or no. Play draws the scale, places where we are today and two competitors, then lands the proposal with a one-line rationale. Positions are illustrative.

split-screen.reason: Completed labeled composition; The slide is cut into two equal halves that use the same layout, so every difference between them is the point. Play fills the left half with today, then the right half with the new state, and finishes by marking the contrast down the middle. Numbers are illustrative.

stacked-bar-waffle.description: Stacked bar / waffle — actual demo stage.
stacked-bar-waffle.reason: Completed labeled composition; The same shares appear twice: a 100% stacked bar, then a 10 × 10 waffle where each square is 1% of revenue. Bars suit precise comparison; waffles make the part-to-whole feel countable. Values are illustrative.

stakeholder-whiteboard.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

stat-with-delta.description: Stat with delta — actual demo stage.
stat-with-delta.reason: Completed labeled composition; The number counts up, then a delta chip shows the change against the comparison period with an arrow and a sign, so direction never depends on color alone. Values are illustrative.

stepper.reason: Selected in-progress frame preserves the distinguishing focus/navigation cue.

surplus-deficit-line.description: Surplus / deficit line — actual demo stage.
surplus-deficit-line.reason: Populated reset composition; The line is monthly cash flow and the dashed line is the target. Area above the target shades green (surplus), area below shades red (deficit). Drag the target slider to see how the balance of good and bad months shifts. Data is illustrative.

swimlane-architecture-board.description: Swimlane architecture board — actual demo stage.
swimlane-architecture-board.reason: Use actual Fit control to show the whole authored flow.

system-context-map.description: System context map — actual demo stage.
system-context-map.reason: Populated reset composition; Zones group the systems by who runs them, the highlighted area is what your team owns, and each connector is labeled with what flows along it. Select any system to light up only its connections and list them below; Reset returns to the owned service. Systems are illustrative.

terminal-typing-animation.description: Terminal typing animation — actual demo stage.
terminal-typing-animation.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each step types the next command character by character in a drawn terminal, then prints its output, so the audience reads at typing speed instead of facing a wall of text. Under reduced motion the full session appears at once. Commands and output are simulated.

tier-cards.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each plan gets a card with the same structure, price first, so the cards compare at a glance. Play deals the three cards in, then lifts and outlines the middle plan with a Most popular tag, the usual way to steer the choice. Prices are illustrative.

timeline-roadmap.reason: Completed labeled composition; A single time axis carries phases as bars above it and milestones as diamonds on it, so plans and dates read together. Play draws the axis, the phases, then the milestones, and drops a Today marker to show where the team is now. Dates are illustrative.

timing-bars-with-budget-line.description: Timing bars with budget line — actual demo stage.
timing-bars-with-budget-line.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

treemap-sunburst.reason: Completed labeled composition; Rectangle area is proportional to budget: column widths split the $10M by department, then each column divides into its teams. Nesting shows hierarchy and size at once; a sunburst shows the same tree as rings. Values are illustrative.

try-it-prototype.reason: Show actual new-flow sharing screen with suggested people and click count; preserve Simulated app label.

type-hover-code-twoslash.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

uncertainty-range.reason: Completed labeled composition; A falsely precise point estimate (1.43 million) appears first, then widens into the honest range, 1.2–1.6 million, and finally a darker inner band marks the likeliest half. The headline changes with it, so the slide never claims more certainty than the model has. Values are illustrative.

upvoted-q-a.reason: Completed labeled composition; Simulated questions arrive and collect votes over about three seconds; the list re-sorts so the question most of the room wants answered rises to the top. Press the ▲ button beside any question to add or remove your own upvote and watch it move. Reset clears votes.

venn-diagram.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each circle is a set and the overlaps show what two or three sets share. Play draws design, engineering and research one at a time, then names the pairwise overlaps and the centre where all three meet. Labels are illustrative.

vertical-2d-slide-stacks.description: Vertical (2D) slide stacks — actual demo stage.
vertical-2d-slide-stacks.reason: Use authored controls to expose the named interaction and its actual visible result.

waterfall-bridge.reason: Completed labeled composition; Bars step from 2025 revenue to 2026 revenue: green steps add, red steps subtract, and dashed connectors carry the running total, so every change visibly sums to the end value. Start and end bars sit on zero. Values are illustrative.

weighted-decision-matrix.description: Weighted decision matrix — actual demo stage.
weighted-decision-matrix.reason: Completed labeled composition; Each criterion gets a weight, each option a 1–5 score, and the total is the sum of score times weight. Play reveals the weights, then the scores, counts up the weighted totals and highlights the winner, which makes the choice auditable. Scores are illustrative.

what-if-calculator.reason: Populated reset composition; Adjust team size, hours saved per person each week and hourly cost; the estimate updates as you type or slide. Savings = people × hours × 46 working weeks × hourly cost. Cost = people × $25 × 12 months. Payback = cost ÷ weekly savings. All figures are illustrative; Reset restores the defaults.

wipe-slider-table.description: Wipe slider table — actual demo stage.
wipe-slider-table.reason: Populated reset composition; The old and new versions of the same table are stacked, and the handle wipes between them row by row: left of it is the old outcome, right of it the new. Drag the handle, use the slider and arrow keys, or jump with Old and New; Reset centres it. Data is illustrative.

word-cloud.reason: Completed labeled composition; Simulated one-word answers arrive over about three seconds; each repeat of a word makes it larger, so the most common answers dominate. Type a word and press Enter or Add to submit your own: it appears outlined and grows if it matches an existing word. Reset clears everything.
